questions.prompt: Describe the product in one sentence.
questions.defaultHint: A tool that helps <audience> do <core action>.

questions.prompt: List the 5-12 core nouns in your domain, and which of them own which others (e.g. a Workspace owns Projects, a Project owns Tasks).
questions.defaultHint: Workspace owns Projects; Project owns Tasks; User; Role.

questions.prompt: Which noun is a URL in your product usually about (e.g. /projects/:id)?
What words do your users actually use for these things? Use their vocabulary, not generic SaaS terms -- the specs will inherit these words verbatim.
questions.defaultHint: Use the nouns from the previous answer as-is.

questions.prompt: Does anything in your domain have a lifecycle with named states (e.g. Draft -> In Review -> Published)? List them.
